liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dancefloors** (1 review): Dancefloors was performed before Run Thru, despite website errors [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Two Halves**: rare: 13 archived performances [15]

## The recordings

- **mmj2008-08-21.mbho.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 29 songs; 170 min; rated 4.25/5 by 8 [1]. Said about its sound: Sounds a little better than the other recording currently on the Archive; Clearer recording where all instruments and Jim James' voice are distinct; Excellent balance in the sound quality of the recording [9][10][13]
- **mmj2008-08-21.km140.702**: source not stated; 29 songs; 169 min; rated 3.5/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording quality is good, though the crowd is a bit talky; Great sound quality, typical for recordings made at the Rocks venue [4][8]

## Around the show

- Reviewer met Black Keys' Dan at Twist and Shout before the show [4]
- Beautiful moonrise over the stage rock in Denver during the performance [7]
- A warm breeze was dancing through the venue that night [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2008-08-21.mbho.flac16**: taped by Eric Foelske; source: MBHO 603a/actives/KA200 > V3 > MT2496 [1]
- **mmj2008-08-21.km140.702**: taped by John Wilson; transferred by John Wilson; source: AK40>LC3>KM100>SD702>wav(24/48) [2]
